text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Für Staubsauger gelten in der Schweiz identische Effizienzanforderungen wie in der EU.", "gist": "Switzerland has the same efficiency requirements for vacuum cleaners as the EU."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "900 Watt", "gist": "Maximum power allowed for vacuum cleaners is 900 watts."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "43 kWh Strom pro Jahr", "gist": "Maximum annual electricity consumption allowed is 43 kWh."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Die kurzzeitig gültige Energieetikette für Staubsauger gilt nicht mehr.", "gist": "The temporarily valid energy label for vacuum cleaners is no longer in effect."}, {"type": "date", "quote": "18.1.2019", "gist": "Date when the European Regulation 665/2013 was declared invalid."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Europäische Verordnung 665/2013", "gist": "European Regulation 665/2013"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Energieeffizienzverordnung (EnEV)", "gist": "Swiss Energy Efficiency Ordinance (EnEV)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Anhang 1.8, Ziffer 4", "gist": "Appendix 1.8, Section 4 of the Energy Efficiency Ordinance"}]}
